import json
T=[];L=[]
for fn,keys in [('my_sents4_01.json',['0','1']),('my_sents4_23.json',['2','3']),('my_sents4_45.json',['4','5']),('my_sents4_67.json',['6','7'])]:
    dd=json.load(open(fn))
    for k in keys: T+=dd[k]; L+=[int(k)]*len(dd[k])
prt=set(p['text'] for p in practice()); old=set(json.load(open('my_sents_all.json'))['texts'])|set(json.load(open('my_sents3_all.json'))['texts'])
print(len(T), 'dup practice', [t for t in T if t in prt], 'dup old', [t for t in T if t in old], len(T)-len(set(T)))
json.dump({'texts':T,'labels':L}, open('my_sents4_all.json','w'))
print(max(len(x['ids']) for x in tokenize(T)))
